market_notes: Simplified-Chinese readers include mainland tourists, business travellers and long-stay workers. A recurring, high-stakes question is whether a Chinese licence can be used at all, alongside 押护照 deposits, insurance and how to deal with 交警. Queries are written without spaces, so overlap scoring uses character bigrams; slugs use pinyin.

proposals.primary_query: 半自动挡摩托车怎么骑
proposals.working_title: 半自动挡摩托车怎么骑：不用离合器的换挡方法
proposals.intent_rationale: Visitors who have only ridden automatic scooters search for how to operate a clutchless semi-automatic before choosing one; how-to intent, distinct from the manual-versus-automatic choice guide.

proposals.primary_query: 越南骑摩托车选多大排量
proposals.working_title: 110cc、125cc还是150cc：城市与山路该选多大排量
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders planning mountain routes compare engine capacity and ask what their licence class permits; complements the 50cc/electric guide, which covers the low-power end.

proposals.primary_query: 本田vision和air blade哪个好
proposals.working_title: 本田Wave、Vision、Air Blade：越南常见车型怎么选
proposals.intent_rationale: Model names are how many renters actually search. Explaining the widely sold Honda families as vehicle types, with no availability claim, captures comparison intent the generic Hub cannot.

proposals.primary_query: 两个人骑摩托车带行李越南
proposals.working_title: 两人骑行带行李：怎样选合适的车
proposals.intent_rationale: Couples and backpackers ask whether one bike can carry two people and luggage safely; a decision guide about load, seating and handling that no existing row answers.

proposals.primary_query: 河内长租摩托车
secondary_queries: 越南摩托车月租留学生
proposals.working_title: 在河内长租摩托车：外派人员与留学生须知
proposals.intent_rationale: Residents, students and long-stay workers rent for months and need maintenance, paperwork and contract answers that a day/week/month price comparison does not cover.

proposals.primary_query: 越南租摩托车押护照
proposals.working_title: 用护照抵押租车：风险与替代方式
proposals.intent_rationale: Leaving an identity document as security is a recurring traveller worry that official travel advice addresses; covers risks and questions to ask, never a provider's policy. Chinese queries use 押护照 phrasing; covers the risk of handing over a passport, not provider practices.

proposals.primary_query: 越南租摩托车隐藏费用
proposals.working_title: 租金以外的费用：油费、停车、送车与损坏
proposals.intent_rationale: People comparing quotes want to know which charges sit outside the rental fee; scoped to cost categories and questions to ask, never to amounts.

proposals.primary_query: 越南摩托车加92还是95汽油
proposals.working_title: 越南加油指南：E5 RON 92还是RON 95
proposals.intent_rationale: First-time riders ask which petrol grade to buy and how stations work; practical, low-risk content that supports cost and breakdown-prevention questions.

proposals.primary_query: 中国驾照在越南能骑摩托车吗
proposals.working_title: 中国驾照能在越南骑摩托车吗？
proposals.intent_rationale: Chinese readers repeatedly ask whether a mainland licence can be used at all; consular reminders stress holding a Vietnamese licence, so the question needs its own carefully sourced page.

proposals.primary_query: 在越南换领摩托车驾照
proposals.working_title: 在越南换领本地摩托车驾照：长期居留者须知
proposals.intent_rationale: Long-stay residents need the conversion route to a Vietnamese licence, a different intent and audience from short-stay visitors asking whether their own licence works.

proposals.primary_query: 越南租的摩托车被偷怎么赔
proposals.working_title: 车辆损坏与被盗：租车合同中的责任条款
proposals.intent_rationale: Disputes over scratches, damage and theft are a major source of rental conflict; explains clauses to read and evidence to keep, without legal promises.
proposals.research_gap: Civil-law liability sources are not attached; drafting must cite the governing civil-code provisions or stay at questions-to-ask level.

proposals.primary_query: 越南骑摩托车保险
secondary_queries: 旅行保险骑摩托车理赔
proposals.working_title: 越南摩托车保险：强制责任险与旅行保险
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders want to know what compulsory liability insurance covers and whether travel insurance pays after a crash; needs current decree references (67/2023 as amended by 220/2026) and policy-specific caveats.

proposals.primary_query: 越南骑摩托车要带什么证件
secondary_queries: 越南摩托车登记证蓝卡
proposals.working_title: 骑车需随身携带哪些证件：车辆登记证等
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders ask which papers to carry if stopped, notably the vehicle registration card ('blue card'); distinct from the rental-documents Hub, which covers renting rather than riding.

proposals.primary_query: 越南骑摩托车头盔要求
proposals.working_title: 越南骑车头盔：标准、尺码与自带头盔
proposals.intent_rationale: Helmets are mandatory and the single biggest injury-prevention factor; readers ask about standards, fit and whether to bring their own.

proposals.primary_query: 河内骑摩托车交通规则
secondary_queries: 越南交通规则摩托车游客
proposals.working_title: 河内骑车实用指南：理解车流与路口通行
proposals.intent_rationale: First-time riders need to understand Hanoi's traffic flow and core rules before riding; distinct from the rain and breakdown guides and from the general safety Hub.

proposals.primary_query: 河内一环禁止燃油摩托车
proposals.working_title: 河内一环低排放区：租车骑行者需要了解什么
proposals.intent_rationale: Hanoi announced a phased low-emission zone for Ring Road 1 starting with a 2026 pilot; renters need a sourced, date-checked explainer that does not overstate what is restricted.

proposals.primary_query: 越南交警查摩托车游客
proposals.working_title: 租车骑行遇到交警检查：需要出示什么
proposals.intent_rationale: Travellers worry about traffic police checks; covers documents to carry and the expected procedure, with no invented fine amounts.

proposals.primary_query: 越南摩托车事故怎么处理
secondary_queries: 租的摩托车撞了怎么办
proposals.working_title: 在越南发生摩托车事故后的第一步
proposals.intent_rationale: After a collision readers need immediate first steps and emergency contacts; distinct from the breakdown guide, which covers mechanical failure.

proposals.primary_query: 河内租摩托车去河江
proposals.working_title: 从河内租摩托车骑行河江环线
proposals.intent_rationale: Many renters plan the Ha Giang Loop from Hanoi. Sits under the proposed routes Hub and stays ARCHITECTURE_BLOCKED until the owner approves that Hub.

proposals.primary_query: 河内骑摩托车去宁平
proposals.working_title: 河内到宁平摩托车一日游
proposals.intent_rationale: Day rides to Ninh Binh are a common first trip outside the city. Part of the proposed routes Hub and blocked until approval.

proposals.primary_query: 越南旅行前学骑离合器摩托车
secondary_queries: 离合器摩托车坡道起步
proposals.working_title: 离合器摩托车怎么骑：去越南骑行前先练好这几步
proposals.intent_rationale: Chinese travellers who only ride electric bikes or automatic scooters at home plan a northern Vietnam loop on a rented manual bike and look for a step-by-step way to learn clutch control before leaving.
proposals.content_angle: A Chinese practice plan for the clutch lever: friction point, first-gear starts, shifting up and down, hill starts and avoiding stalls, each tied to Hanoi stop-and-go traffic and steep mountain passes in the north.

proposals.primary_query: 越南酒驾标准 摩托车
secondary_queries: 喝一杯啤酒能骑摩托车吗 越南
proposals.working_title: 越南酒驾标准：骑摩托车为什么一杯啤酒都不行
proposals.intent_rationale: Chinese riders want to know whether a single beer at dinner already makes riding a rented scooter in Vietnam illegal, and what a breath test or an accident after drinking means for a tourist.
proposals.content_angle: Explains Vietnam's zero-alcohol rule for all motor vehicles, breath checks and penalty tiers under Decree 168/2024, the Chinese Embassy's note that many accidents involving Chinese citizens involved drinking, and evening plans without riding.

proposals.primary_query: 越南摩托车限速
secondary_queries: 越南市区摩托车最高时速
proposals.working_title: 越南摩托车限速：市区、郊外和国道怎么区分
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders planning longer rides outside Hanoi want the actual limits for motorbikes inside and outside residential areas, because Vietnamese limits depend on road layout and vehicle class rather than on posted signs alone.
proposals.content_angle: Tabulates motorbike and 50cc moped limits under Circular 38/2024 by road type, explains why motorbikes stay off expressways, how cameras and penalties work and how to read the local limit signs.

proposals.primary_query: 外国人在越南考摩托车驾照
secondary_queries: 越南长住考摩托车驾照
河内摩托车理论和路考
proposals.working_title: 外国人在越南考摩托车驾照（A1）：考试流程与所需材料
proposals.intent_rationale: Chinese residents in Hanoi whose home licence has no motorcycle class cannot convert one into an A1 entitlement, so they want to know how to sit the Vietnamese A1 test instead.
proposals.content_angle: Walks through the Vietnamese A1 test route for foreign residents: eligibility, documents, theory and riding tests, where to register and licence validity, clearly separated from converting a Chinese licence, which another guide covers.

proposals.primary_query: 越南交通标志 摩托车
secondary_queries: 越南禁止摩托车通行标志
越南摩托车专用道标志
越南红灯右转辅助标志
proposals.working_title: 越南交通标志图解：骑摩托车必须认识的标志
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders who cannot read Vietnamese want to recognise the signs that change what a scooter may do, such as motorbike bans, lane assignments and turning rules, because several look different from Chinese signs.
proposals.content_angle: A sign-by-sign guide to the Vietnamese road signs that matter on a scooter under QCVN 41:2024, grouped by the decision a rider must make, with notes on supplementary plates.

proposals.primary_query: 河内冬天骑摩托车
secondary_queries: 越南北部冬天骑车穿什么
proposals.working_title: 河内冬天骑摩托车：湿冷、毛毛雨和装备准备
proposals.intent_rationale: Chinese visitors travelling between December and February expect tropical warmth and meet damp cold and drizzle in the north; they want to know how riding conditions change and what to pack.
proposals.content_angle: Covers the cool season in Hanoi and the northern mountains from a rider's view: humid cold, drizzle and slick roads, visibility, layering and gloves, and how cold spells affect day trips, distinct from the summer rains.

proposals.primary_query: 越南骑摩托车穿什么
secondary_queries: 摩托车雨衣还是雨披 越南
proposals.working_title: 在越南骑摩托车穿什么：防晒、防雨和防护
proposals.intent_rationale: Travellers packing for a scooter trip want concrete clothing advice that balances protection against heat, sun and sudden downpours, beyond the helmet rules covered by another guide.
proposals.content_angle: A packing and wearing guide for Vietnam's climate: abrasion-resistant layers, gloves and closed shoes, rain gear that is safe on a scooter and sun protection, with what to buy locally and what to bring from home.

proposals.primary_query: 河内摩托车防盗
proposals.working_title: 河内摩托车防盗：停车、上锁和防飞车抢夺
proposals.intent_rationale: Renters who remain responsible for the scooter during the rental want practical habits that keep the bike and their belongings safe in Hanoi before anything goes wrong.
proposals.content_angle: Prevention only: where and how to park, locks, keys and papers, snatch thefts of phones and bags from passing bikes and night-time habits, kept separate from the question of who pays after a theft.

proposals.primary_query: 河内摩托车停车
secondary_queries: 河内老城区摩托车停车场
proposals.working_title: 河内摩托车停车指南：看管停车场、停车票和人行道禁停
proposals.intent_rationale: Visitors riding into the Old Quarter or to sights want to know where a scooter may be left, how attended parking with paper tickets works and what happens if a bike is left on a pavement where it is not allowed.
proposals.content_angle: Explains how scooter parking works in Hanoi: attended lots and tickets, the city's official parking-fee rules, pavement restrictions and impounding, with practical tips for sights, cafés and night markets.

proposals.primary_query: 越南夜间骑摩托车注意事项
secondary_queries: 越南摩托车几点必须开灯
越南远光灯近光灯规定
晚上骑摩托车安全吗 越南
proposals.working_title: 越南夜间骑摩托车：车灯规定与安全建议
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders who return from dinner or day trips after dark want to know Vietnam's lighting rules and whether foreign governments advise against riding at night before deciding how to plan evenings.
proposals.content_angle: Explains the lighting rules of Law 36/2024 Article 20 (headlights from 18:00 to 06:00 and in poor visibility, when to dip the beam), why several governments advise avoiding night travel, and practical night-time alternatives.

proposals.primary_query: 越南骑摩托车能用手机导航吗
secondary_queries: 越南摩托车手机支架合法吗
proposals.working_title: 越南骑摩托车时用手机：法律禁止什么、允许什么
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders who navigate with a phone want to know exactly what the amended Vietnamese law prohibits, whether a handlebar mount or earphones are allowed and how violations are handled, before setting up navigation on a rental bike.
proposals.content_angle: Separates what is banned (holding and using a phone while moving under Article 9, audio devices under Article 33) from what remains allowed, explains the 2025 amendment and gives a legal navigation set-up for a rented scooter.
